workflow: inert deposit intent or staff exception
acceptance: accepted prices resolve to the fixed rule table
identical replay creates at most one follow-up and one deposit intent
same event id with different bytes returns EVENT_CONFLICT
invalid or under-budget inquiries create one staff exception
crash/resume and rollback preserve a machine-readable receipt
payments processed equals zero until a hosted processor proves otherwise

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: browser-local synthetic or de-identified input; no server submission
